description: Known answer for the loka-cartridge-v2 content hash of cartridges/ashmere_items (R5 S4; 05 §11; CartridgeArtifact.content_hash): two rooms (one detail), one NPC with a capacity, and three items (entity.schema.json ItemDefinition, NpcDefinition): one in a room with a room-line variant whose condition is has_item, one container item with a capacity in a room, and one inside it; text with touch links. Assembled by hand from the source files (manifest without entry, the lock, empty facts, policies and actions, each room, NPC and item with key added and short references expanded, entry, text), its canonical bytes by Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) and sha256 by hashlib, never by the kernels. For these values (no numbers beyond small integers, no control characters, one non-ASCII character) Python's output is the loka-numeric-v1 encoding. R5 S6b (PM ruling on the owner's request that existing cartridges get the pools): the compiler adds resource@1 to requires and the lock and the default pools hp 0..20 start 20 gain 5, ma 0..100 start 100 gain 4 and mv 0..82 start 82 gain 18 (resource.schema.json ResourceSpec), added here by hand to the previous value. Review #49 A1 (PM ruling): the compiler also adds schedule@1 with the pools, so wait can regenerate an exhausted body; added here by hand to requires and the lock.

text.room.ferry_landing.title: Ferry Landing
text.room.ferry_landing.description: Reeds crowd a slick wooden landing. A [mooring post](mooring_post) leans into the current.
text.room.village_green.title: Village Green
text.room.village_green.description: An old elm shades a patch of trodden grass.
text.detail.mooring_post: Rope has worn a groove into the [post]. Someone has carved a fox into it.
text.npc.bram.room: [Bram] the ferryman stands here, one boot on the ferry.
text.npc.bram.description: A ferryman with rope-scarred hands and a coat that has never been dry.
text.item.lantern.room: A [brass lantern] lies in the weeds.
text.item.lantern.room_oil: A [brass lantern] lies in the weeds, dry. The oil you carry would fill it.
text.item.lantern.description: Dented brass, its reservoir dry. It would light a fen path.
text.item.satchel.room: A leather [satchel] leans against a crate.
text.item.satchel.description: Scuffed leather, buckled shut over something that sloshes.
text.item.lamp_oil.room: A [flask of lamp oil] stands here.
text.item.lamp_oil.description: Thick yellow oil, enough for one lantern.
